stem.text: The diagram shows a section through a cell surface membrane.

stem.alt: Cross-section of a cell surface membrane showing phospholipid bilayer, membrane proteins, and carbohydrate chains, with labels P, Q, R and S.

stem.text: What is a correct role for a labelled molecule?

A.text: P is involved in controlling membrane stability.

B.text: Q is involved in active transport.

C.text: R is involved in cell signalling.

D.text: S is involved in diffusion of ions.
